BlueInk Privacy & Security

This article will help you understand BlueInk's privacy measures and policy.

Written by Raymund Mission
April 23, 2020

Privacy & security is one of BlueInk's top priority.

We have created an entire "Legal Menu" where you can find details on our Terms of Use, Privacy, Acceptable Use, and Cookie policies. If you ever have any questions or feedback in regards to our policies and practices we're here to listen!

Contact us at legal@blueink.com or send us a support message using the the messenger at the bottom right of your screen.

Either way, our team will get back to you immediately!
